items.textEn: Avoid prolonged water exposure — skip dishwashing, long baths, and swimming.
items.textZh: 避免长时间接触水 — 洗碗、泡澡和游泳请暂缓。

items.textEn: Avoid applying pressure directly to the tips of your nails.
items.textZh: 避免对指甲尖端施加直接压力。

items.textEn: Allow the gel to fully cure before heavy activity.
items.textZh: 在进行繁重活动前，请确保光疗胶完全固化。

items.textEn: Apply cuticle oil once or twice daily to keep nails and skin hydrated.
items.textZh: 每日涂抹一至两次护甲油，保持指甲和皮肤水润。

items.textEn: Moisturize your hands regularly, especially after washing.
items.textZh: 经常给双手保湿，尤其是洗手之后。

items.textEn: Avoid using your nails as tools — do not pry, pick, or scrape with them.
items.textZh: 避免用指甲作为工具 — 不要用指甲撬、抠或刮物品。

items.textEn: Wear protective gloves when cleaning, doing dishes, or using harsh chemicals.
items.textZh: 清洁、洗碗或使用强效化学品时，请戴上防护手套。

items.textEn: Avoid prolonged contact with acetone-based products (e.g., nail polish remover).
items.textZh: 避免长时间接触含丙酮的产品（如卸甲水）。

items.textEn: Apply sunscreen to your hands — UV exposure can fade nail colour over time.
items.textZh: 给双手涂抹防晒霜 — 紫外线照射会使指甲颜色随时间褪色。

items.textEn: Do not peel, pick, or force-remove gel — this damages the natural nail underneath.
items.textZh: 不要撕、抠或强行卸除光疗胶 — 这会损伤下方的天然甲。

items.textEn: If a nail lifts or chips, contact the studio — do not attempt to fix it yourself.
items.textZh: 如果指甲翘起或崩裂，请联系工作室 — 不要自行尝试修复。

items.textEn: If you notice any pain, swelling, or irritation around your nails, consult a healthcare professional.
items.textZh: 如果您注意到指甲周围有疼痛、肿胀或刺激感，请咨询医疗专业人员。

items.textEn: Professional removal is strongly recommended to protect your natural nails.
items.textZh: 强烈建议进行专业卸甲，以保护您的天然甲。

items.textEn: Book a removal appointment when ready — we'll safely soak off or file down your set.
items.textZh: 准备好时请预约卸甲服务 — 我们将安全地浸泡或打磨卸除您的指甲。

items.textEn: Allow your nails a short rest between sets if they feel thin or sensitive.
items.textZh: 如果指甲感觉变薄或敏感，请在两次做甲之间给指甲短暂休息时间。
